# Galimos rolės finansų organizacijose trijų linijų modelis


## 1 linija – verslas / veikla

Payments Operations Specialist
Customer Support Specialist
Product Manager
Account Manager
Sales Manager
Credit Analyst
Loan Officer
Fraud Operations Specialist
KYC Analyst – priklauso nuo konkrečios organizacijos struktūros
IT / Software Engineer
Finance Manager
Treasury Specialist
Branch Manager


## 🟡 2 linija – Risk / Compliance

Compliance Officer
Head of Compliance
AML Officer
AML/KYC Manager
MLRO (Money Laundering Reporting Officer)
Risk Manager
Operational Risk Manager
Enterprise Risk Manager
Information Security Risk Manager
Regulatory Compliance Specialist
Compliance Monitoring Specialist
Data Protection Officer (DPO)
Financial Crime Officer
Fraud Risk Manager


## 🔵 3 linija – Internal Audit
## Nepriklausomo vertinimo funkcija:

Internal Auditor
Senior Internal Auditor
IT Auditor
Compliance Auditor
Risk Auditor
Head of Internal Audit
Chief Audit Executive (CAE)


## Vadovybė

CEO / General Manager
CFO
COO
Chief Risk Officer (CRO)
Chief Compliance Officer (CCO)
Board Member
Audit Committee Member
Risk Committee Member
